$comment: Source of truth for the bar/dispensary UniFi build. Passphrases are NEVER stored here - each WLAN names an environment variable the provisioning script reads at runtime.

networks.name: MGMT
networks.note: Default LAN. Re-address the existing network by hand rather than creating a duplicate.

networks.name: BAR-POS
networks.note: POS terminals, KDS, card readers, receipt printers

networks.name: BAR-IOT
networks.note: TVs, digital menu boards, cooler sensors, music

networks.name: GUEST
networks.note: /23 spans 10.0.30.0-10.0.31.255 (510 usable). A /22 anchored at .30 is not a valid boundary - it normalises to 10.0.28.0/22 and the DHCP range is rejected. Short lease so a busy Friday recycles addresses.

networks.name: STAFF
networks.note: 10.0.40.x, NOT 10.0.31.x - the guest /23 (10.0.30.0-10.0.31.255) swallows 10.0.31.0/24. Fallback network if RADIUS dynamic VLAN is not used.

wlans.name: Fields Guest
wlans.note: Pair with a captive portal in Settings > Hotspot. Rename to the venue's actual name before applying.

wlans.name: Venue Staff
wlans.note: PSK fallback only. The design calls for WPA-Enterprise with dynamic VLAN - build that in the UI, see docs section 5.

wlans.name: BAR-POS
wlans.note: Handhelds and tablets only. Wire fixed terminals.

wlans.name: DISP-POS
wlans.note: Handhelds and tablets only. Wire fixed terminals.

firewall_policies.why: The entire point of the build
Plus client isolation on the SSID itself
Staff phones never touch card networks
Admin reaches Mgmt from a jump host only

manual_steps: Zone-based firewall: create the zones above, then the policies, default-deny between zones first
RADIUS + dynamic VLAN for the staff SSID (bar accounts -> VLAN 11, dispensary -> VLAN 21)
AP Groups 'bar' (3 APs) and 'dispensary' (2 APs) before applying the POS WLANs
DHCP guard with trusted server addresses on every network
5G Backup failover scoping - POS allowed, guest excluded, alert under 10 GB
RF tuning pass: 5 GHz at 40 MHz, min RSSI -72, low data rates disabled, TX power medium
Per-zone bandwidth limits on the primary WAN
